subject: Make Shiny less chatty & load new static page when client disconnects

messages.author: f562cc721b7e9a13
messages.subject: Make Shiny less chatty & load new static page when client disconnects
parts:
On desktops with dedicated Internet, this isn't quite so important. But on cell phones or mobile connected desktops, I would like for simple apps to be "less chatty" with the server. Is there a config option to achieve this? Another approach?

Also, on my cell phone tests, I notice much quicker disconnects occurring (locking phone then returning in 10 minutes or using another app for a while.) How can I either force a reconnection or a redirect to another static page so the users know how to return to the app without seeing a gray screen?

Best,
Stephen
